  "thinking": "Table's empty and the clock is running, so someone needs to set the plan. A fish has a clean outline and a telltale tail, so I'll take the pad and sketch one, starting at the tail tip.",
  "say": "I'll grab the pad and sketch a fish: tail on the left, body going right. Shout if you'd rather do something else.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 6,
  "point": [2, 10],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[2,10],[4,8],[6,6],[9,6],[14,7],[20,8],[25,9],[27,10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[2,10],[4,12],[6,14],[9,14],[14,13],[20,12],[25,11],[27,10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[6,6],[3,3],[2,10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[2,10],[3,17],[6,14]]},
    {"type": "circle", "cx": 22, "cy": 9, "r": 0.8},
    {"type": "label", "x": 2, "y": 10, "text": "START"}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Plan: fish facing right. Stroke 1 = top edge from tail tip (START) to nose; stroke 2 = bottom edge; strokes 3-4 = forked tail fin at the rear. Eye at around x=22, y=9. Nobody has taken the pad yet; I'm holding it. Build by tracing 1, 2, 3, 4 once the sketch is checked."
